mapper.select: select userCode, userId, userPwd, userImg, userNickname, userName, userCreate, userUpdate, userDelete, userManager, userYn, userStopYn, userStopDate, LEAST( 100, userTotalPointer + ( SELECT IFNULL(SUM(userPointer), 0) FROM JGUserInfoPointer WHERE userCode = JGUserInfo.userCode ) ) AS userTotalPointer, addressData, addressDetailData, userAddressDetail, userInfo from jguserinfo where userCode = #{code};
select * from JGNotice where userCode = #{code} and JGNoticeSaleUserCode is null and JGNoticeProductPrice != 0;
select * from JGNotice where userCode = #{code} and JGNoticeSaleUserCode is not null;
select * from JGNotice where JGNoticeProductPrice = 0 AND userCode = #{code};
